en: Duran - Good heavens, the prince is nowhere to be seen.
GS - The villagers say he left at dawn, saying he was going for a walk. I think he's gone to the Ice Castle.
Iyolin - That fool... Causing trouble even here!
Duran - I knew the prince liked to do strange things, but...
GS - The Ice Castle is one of the famous Eight Wonders. I have a bad feeling about this. I'll go and look for the prince.
GS - No. On a battlefield numbers help, but in a dungeon they're more of a hindrance. I can search more effectively on my own.
Iyolin - Even so, I'll help you look. The rest of you, please wait here for now.
